description: Plan a release rollback from its diff: feature flags first, then env changes, then database migrations in reverse order, with manual and blocked steps flagged.

env_changes.description: Environment variable changes the release made (optional)

action.description: What the release did to the variable: added, changed, or removed

name.description: Environment variable name (unique across the set)

previous_value_known.description: True when the pre-release value is recorded (optional, default false)

feature_flags.description: Feature flag changes the release made (optional)

change.description: What the release did to the flag: enabled, disabled, added, or removed

name.description: Feature flag name (unique across the set)

migrations.description: Migrations the release applied, in application order (optional)

down_id.description: Identifier of a compensating migration that undoes this one (optional)

reversible.description: True when the migration ships a down migration (optional, default true)

release.description: Release identifier or version being rolled back

name: plan_rollback
